mipnerf360/bicycle.text: Tip: Look at the brick building above the hedge at top right, which MeshSplatting erases into white sky.

mipnerf360/flowers.text: Tip: Look at the small conifer at top left, whose pointed top 2DGS rounds off into a dome.

mipnerf360/garden.text: Tip: Look at the lawn behind the table's right side, where Hexels keep slightly crisper grass blades than 2DGS.

mipnerf360/stump.text: Tip: Look at the thin weed stalk in the grass at the right edge, which 2DGS nearly erases.

mipnerf360/treehill.text: Tip: Look at the railing just right of the stone wall, where 2DGS drops a stretch of the top rail.

mipnerf360/room.text: Tip: Look at the dark rim atop the tall white cylinder at top right, which 2DGS breaks in two.

mipnerf360/counter.text: Tip: Look at the floor tiles in the bottom-left corner, where 2DGS smooths away the grout lines.

mipnerf360/kitchen.text: Tip: Look at the placemat right of the bulldozer's bucket, which MeshSplatting covers with large dark triangles.

mipnerf360/bonsai.text: Tip: Look at the lower fold of the purple cloth, where 2DGS adds pale needle-like streaks.

tanks_and_temples/Train.text: Tip: Look at the shaded gravel in the foreground, where Hexels keep individual stones that 2DGS smooths into a flat sheet.

tanks_and_temples/Truck.text: Tip: Look at the turquoise hood, clean in Hexels but briefly crossed by dark streak floaters in Triangle Splatting.

tanks_and_temples/Francis.text: Tip: Look at the top of the monument, where a pale 2DGS floater slices diagonally through the cornice beside the left eagle.

tanks_and_temples/Horse.text: Tip: Look at the white tower behind the horse: Hexels keep its roof, which 2DGS dissolves into the sky.

tanks_and_temples/Lighthouse.text: Tip: Look at the tree under the gable's left eave, where a bright white 2DGS floater covers much of its crown.

tanks_and_temples/Barn.text: Tip: Look at the sky just above the roof's right half, where Triangle Splatting leaves a thin dark streak floater.

tanks_and_temples/Caterpillar.text: Tip: Look at the sky above the trees right of the cab, where 2DGS shows a dark blue floater.

tanks_and_temples/Courthouse.text: Tip: Look at the dome above the roofline: Hexels keep it, while 2DGS loses it in the sky.

tanks_and_temples/Ignatius.text: Tip: Look at the conifer above the roof at the top right, whose upper part 2DGS loses in the sky.

tanks_and_temples/Meetingroom.text: Tip: Look through the far-left windows: Hexels show the trees and house outside, which 2DGS washes into a pale haze.

dtu/scan24.text: Tip: Look at the golden top of the clock tower, where 2DGS adds a glowing yellow-green blob.

dtu/scan37.text: Tip: Look at the white label on the red handle, where Hexels keep the printed digits that 2DGS blurs away.

dtu/scan40.text: Tip: Look just above the top stone block, where 2DGS adds a large gray clump of debris.

dtu/scan55.text: Tip: Look just right of the bunny's ears, where 2DGS adds brown leaf-like floaters.

dtu/scan63.text: Tip: Look at the pumpkin's stem, which Triangle Splatting cuts with a dark vertical sliver.

dtu/scan65.text: Tip: Look at the far right end of the table's back edge, which 2DGS cuts off with a dark wedge.

dtu/scan69.text: Tip: Look left of the middle snowman's top hat, where 2DGS adds a brown flaky floater.

dtu/scan83.text: Tip: Look at the orange bar at the left edge, which 2DGS loses except for a short stub at its upper end.

dtu/scan97.text: Tip: Look at the table right of the white bag, which 2DGS covers with a dark floater streaked red and green.

dtu/scan105.text: Tip: Look at the table corner right of the plush toy, which 2DGS cuts off with a black wedge.

dtu/scan106.text: Tip: Look at the end of the wooden table left of the two birds, which 2DGS replaces with black and a teal band.

dtu/scan110.text: Tip: Look at the table at the lower left, where 2DGS adds a glowing white blob with pink streaks.

dtu/scan114.text: Tip: Look at the table's end left of the Buddha, which 2DGS cuts off with a black wedge and a blue-green streak.

dtu/scan118.text: Tip: Look at the table's right end, where 2DGS leaves a dark gap with a green line, a green blob and a magenta streak.

dtu/scan122.text: Tip: Look at the dark background left of the owl's head, where 2DGS shows a bright white floater.

mipnerf360/garden.3dgs: Tip: Drag the crosshair over the football under the table: Hexel primitives follow its panels, 3DGS uses soft blobs.
mipnerf360/garden.2dgs: Tip: Drag the crosshair over the football under the table: Hexel primitives follow its panels, 2DGS uses soft blobs.

mipnerf360/bicycle.3dgs: Tip: Drag the crosshair over the front wheel: Hexels draw the spokes as long thin strips, unlike 3DGS.

mipnerf360/counter.3dgs: Tip: On the floor at the far left, Hexels keep a grout line and crumb that 3DGS smooths away.

dtu/scan24.3dgs: Tip: Look at the gray roof at the lower left, where 3DGS leaves a bright white streak.

quad.dtu/scan65: Tip: Drag the crosshair over the top of the skull: Hexel primitives cover it with large, crisp-edged polygons.

mipnerf360/bicycle.text: Tip: Look at the rear wheel at bottom right, where 2DGS loses the pedal, the chainring and the lower half of the tyre.

mipnerf360/flowers.text: Tip: Look at the orange flowers on thin stems above the left plant, which 2DGS blurs away, leaving one bare stalk.

mipnerf360/stump.text: Tip: Look at the knot on the side of the stump, which 2DGS blurs into a pale smudge, losing the ridged bark around it.

mipnerf360/garden.text: Tip: Look at the space under the table, where 2DGS drops the legs, the crossbar and the football, leaving the top floating.

mipnerf360/treehill.text: Tip: Look at the bench corner at the foot of the tree, where 2DGS keeps only the front plank and loses legs and roots.

mipnerf360/room.text: Tip: Look at the footstool in the middle, which 2DGS hides behind a streaky smear while Hexels keep its bent wooden legs.

mipnerf360/counter.text: Tip: Look at the braided loaf in its bag at bottom right, which 2DGS blurs into a brown smudge with no sesame seeds.

mipnerf360/kitchen.text: Tip: Look at the crawler track on the left of the bulldozer, which 2DGS melts into a smooth black blob with no links.

mipnerf360/bonsai.text: Tip: Look at the open cardboard box at top left, which 2DGS covers with a pink and beige smear.

tanks_and_temples/Train.text: Tip: Look at the WESTERN PACIFIC lettering, where 2DGS erases PACIFIC down to two stray strokes.

tanks_and_temples/Truck.text: Tip: Look at the rear wheel and its lettered mud flap, which 2DGS washes out into a grey haze.

tanks_and_temples/Francis.text: Tip: Look at the top of the monument, where 2DGS cuts a white sky streak through the carved canopy and its bird statues.

tanks_and_temples/Horse.text: Tip: Look at the lamp post and yellow crossing sign at right, which 2DGS dissolves into a dark green blur.

tanks_and_temples/Lighthouse.text: Tip: Look at the pine branches by the roof eave at right, which 2DGS dissolves into a pale blue haze.

tanks_and_temples/Barn.text: Tip: Look at the red wavy bike rack at left, which 2DGS erases completely, leaving only grass and grey smear.

tanks_and_temples/Caterpillar.text: Tip: Look at the bucket teeth at bottom right, which 2DGS smears into a brown blur while Hexels keep each tooth.

tanks_and_temples/Courthouse.text: Tip: Look at the right end of the top parapet, where 2DGS washes the upper stone face and its top edge into white haze.

tanks_and_temples/Ignatius.text: Tip: Look at the white building at top left, which 2DGS blurs away while Hexels keep its windows and red door.

tanks_and_temples/Meetingroom.text: Tip: Look at the chandelier at top left, where 2DGS keeps only a few glowing shades and loses the iron ring.

dtu/scan24.text: Tip: Look at the clock tower behind the roof, which 2DGS loses entirely while Hexels keep its gold trim and clock faces.

dtu/scan37.text: Tip: Look at the right end of the lower brick, which 2DGS melts into a beige blur while Hexels keep its corner and stone grain.

dtu/scan40.text: Tip: Look through the arch opening, which 2DGS fills with a brown fog instead of showing the white table behind it.

dtu/scan55.text: Tip: Look at the rabbit's chest and front paws, which 2DGS paints as a smooth grey sheet while Hexels keep the fur.

dtu/scan63.text: Tip: Look at the right half of the pumpkin, which 2DGS dissolves into an orange haze while Hexels keep its round outline.

dtu/scan65.text: Tip: Look at the lower jaw behind the teeth, which 2DGS fades into the table while Hexels keep the whole jawbone.

dtu/scan69.text: Tip: Look at the small snowman on the right, whose hat and face 2DGS blurs into a dark cone with no carrot nose.

dtu/scan83.text: Tip: Look at the grey block behind the smurf's legs, which 2DGS loses entirely and replaces with a dark red and black smear.

dtu/scan97.text: Tip: Look at the green muesli bag on the right, whose label and outline 2DGS smears into the table while Hexels keep the lettering.

dtu/scan105.text: Tip: Look beside the bear's outstretched arm on the right, where 2DGS floats a bright white glare and drops the grey block behind it.

dtu/scan106.text: Tip: Look at the table right of the birds' tails, where 2DGS leaves a dark hole with a purple floater and loses the table edge.

dtu/scan110.text: Tip: Look at the table right of the gold figure, where 2DGS floats a bright white glare and a yellow streak over the surface.

dtu/scan114.text: Tip: Look at the table just right of the buddha, which 2DGS replaces with a dark void crossed by a magenta haze and a red streak.

dtu/scan118.text: Tip: Look at the statuette's ringed base and the table beside it, which 2DGS smears and crosses with red and yellow streaks.

dtu/scan122.text: Tip: Look at the stack of books under the owl, which 2DGS loses entirely, leaving the top book floating over a dark smudge.

mipnerf360/bicycle.text: Tip: Look at the handlebars and saddle in the middle, which 2DGS buries under a pale blur along with the hedge behind.

mipnerf360/flowers.text: Tip: Look at the canna plant in the middle, whose leaves and orange flowers 2DGS smears into a brown blur.

mipnerf360/garden.text: Tip: Look at the table leg and paving stones at bottom right, which 2DGS wipes out into a flat brown smear.

mipnerf360/stump.text: Tip: Look at the wooden stakes and strap at right, which 2DGS dissolves into a brown blur along with the log behind.

mipnerf360/treehill.text: Tip: Look at the bench corner at bottom left, where 2DGS loses the legs and tree roots in a pale glowing blur.

mipnerf360/room.text: Tip: Look at the floorboards beside the potted plant at left, where 2DGS smooths away the plank seams and nail holes.

mipnerf360/counter.text: Tip: Look at the bread in the plastic bag at bottom centre, where 2DGS smears the braid and sesame seeds into a blob.

mipnerf360/kitchen.text: Tip: Look at the wooden table edge at left, where 2DGS covers the wood grain with pale milky blotches.

mipnerf360/bonsai.text: Tip: Look at the knitted tablecloth corner at bottom left, which 2DGS flattens into smooth cloth with stray grid lines.

tanks_and_temples/Horse.text: Tip: Look at the palm tree left of the horse, whose crown 2DGS breaks into a pale smear while Hexels keep its fronds.

tanks_and_temples/Truck.text: Tip: Look at the front wheel and lower door, which 2DGS hides behind a grey haze floater while Hexels keep the hubcap and lettering.

tanks_and_temples/Lighthouse.text: Tip: Look at the right half of the tree below the gable, which 2DGS hides behind a pale haze floater while Hexels keep its foliage.

tanks_and_temples/Ignatius.text: Tip: Look at the white building at top right, whose windows, roof and palm 2DGS blurs into a smear while Hexels keep them.

tanks_and_temples/Francis.text: Tip: Look at the dark tilted tower at right, whose top 2DGS dissolves into grey fog while Hexels keep its sharp roofline.

tanks_and_temples/Caterpillar.text: Tip: Look at the tall conifer at top right, whose pointed top 2DGS rounds off into a dark dome while Hexels keep the spire.

tanks_and_temples/Train.text: Tip: Look at the shaded gravel at bottom left, where Hexels keep individual stones that 2DGS smooths into a flat blue sheet.

tanks_and_temples/Meetingroom.text: Tip: Look at the far-left windows, where Hexels show the trees and house outside that 2DGS washes into a pale haze.

tanks_and_temples/Courthouse.text: Tip: Look at the stone cornice at top left, where a white 2DGS streak floater washes out the wall that Hexels keep intact.

tanks_and_temples/Barn.text: Tip: Look at the pavement in front of the garage door, where 2DGS leaves a dark smudge and sharp white streaks.

dtu/scan24.text: Tip: Look at the clock tower at the top, which 2DGS hides behind dark streaks and star-shaped floaters.

dtu/scan37.text: Tip: Look at the right end of the front brick under the black clamp, where 2DGS replaces the pitted stone with scratchy streaks and a smear.

dtu/scan40.text: Tip: Look at the opening under the arch, where 2DGS eats into the left pillar with a ragged white blob and black specks.

dtu/scan55.text: Tip: Look at the table corner right of the rabbit's ears, where 2DGS smears brown and teal streaks across the edge.

dtu/scan63.text: Tip: Look at the stacked apples in front of the pumpkin, whose speckled skin 2DGS blurs into smooth smudges.

dtu/scan65.text: Tip: Look at the back of the skull on the right, where 2DGS smears a dark haze over its outline and the cloth behind.

dtu/scan69.text: Tip: Look at the cloth left of the small green-hatted snowman, where 2DGS hangs a dark red and blue curtain of streaks.

dtu/scan83.text: Tip: Look at the cloth right of the smurf, where 2DGS draws a long dark pole-like streak down onto the table.

dtu/scan97.text: Tip: Look at the cloth behind the muesli bag on the right, where 2DGS leaves a black hole with a green speck.

dtu/scan105.text: Tip: Look at the teddy bear's body and legs, which 2DGS buries under a bright radial smear.

dtu/scan106.text: Tip: Look at the cloth right of the bird's tail, where 2DGS scatters a trail of black specks.

dtu/scan110.text: Tip: Look at the cloth right of the golden figurine, where 2DGS spreads a dark smoky haze with grey blobs.

dtu/scan114.text: Tip: Look at the cloth right of the buddha, where 2DGS dissolves the table corner into dark smears and a purple streak.

dtu/scan118.text: Tip: Look at the cloth right of the angel, where 2DGS lays a dark wedge-shaped floater and a white smear on the table edge.

dtu/scan122.text: Tip: Look at the table to the right of the owl, where 2DGS lays a large green floater over the cloth.
